rules.what: A prompt still calls the removed memory episode action.
rules.why: zmem-mcp exposes Orchestrator_reflect instead; the old action does not exist.
rules.fix: Replace it with Orchestrator_reflect(action:"record", task, worked, failed, pattern, outcome, agent).

rules.description: No knowledge layer on memory recall
rules.what: A prompt asks memory recall for the removed knowledge layer.
rules.why: Knowledge is a separate tool in zmem-mcp.

rules.what: The repo config registers a plugin entry.
rules.why: OpenCode V2 rejects the v1 plugin API and fails config load.
rules.fix: Delete the plugin key; move behavior into instructions, skills, or the MCP server.

rules.description: No absolute drive path in the repo config
rules.what: The repo config hardcodes an absolute drive path.
rules.why: The repo is shared across machines; paths are owned by the global merge script.

rules.what: An agent prompt, command template, instruction, or MCP binary is missing.
rules.why: OpenCode silently drops agents and commands with broken references.
rules.fix: Run python scripts/zara-cli.py config validate and restore the reported file.

rules.why: A session without AGENTS.md has no startup path or verification contract.
Cross-session continuity depends on tracked state, not chat history.
rules.fix: Restore PROGRESS.md with Current State, Next Steps, and Blockers.

rules.why: Scope and evidence live there; without it WIP=1 cannot be enforced.

rules.what: The shared instruction file is missing.
rules.why: Every agent inherits it; without it behavior diverges.

rules.what: The MCP submodule is not initialized or not pinned.
rules.why: The memory server is the dependency; an unpinned tree is not reproducible.

rules.description: Agent prompts follow the harness template
rules.what: An agent prompt is missing a template section, has them out of order, or duplicates the shared contract.
rules.why: Divergent prompts are how one agent quietly stops verifying its claims.
rules.fix: Restore the 8 sections in order: Role, Inputs, Procedure, Verification Duty, Output Contract, Failure Modes, Budget, Boundaries.

rules.what: The portable MCP declaration drifted from the runtime config.
rules.why: Two sources of truth for MCP servers means one of them is wrong.
rules.fix: Run python scripts/zara-cli.py config export-mcp and commit the regenerated .mcp.json.

rules.description: Feature list uses the standard schema
rules.cmd: python -c "import json;d=json.load(open('feature_list.json',encoding='utf-8'));f=d['features'];assert f and all(k in x for x in f for k in ('id','behavior','verification','state'));assert all(x['state'] in ('planned','active','passing','blocked') for x in f)"
rules.what: A feature entry is missing id, behavior, verification, or state, or uses an unknown state.
rules.why: The gate, VCR, and the course audit all read these keys; a rename silently breaks them.
rules.fix: Use state values planned|active|passing|blocked and the keys id, behavior, verification, state.

rules.description: No shell script carries repo logic (zara-cli only)
rules.cmd: python -c "import pathlib,sys;skip=('mcp/','.git/','.opencode/skills/','additional-skills/');bad=[p.as_posix() for p in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('*.sh') if not p.as_posix().startswith(skip)];print(bad) if bad else None;sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"
rules.what: A .sh file outside the skill assets exists in the repo.
rules.why: Two implementations of one gate drift; the harness entry point must stay one Python CLI.
rules.fix: Port the logic into scripts/zara_cli/ and expose it as a zara-cli subcommand.

rules.description: The Python environment is locked by uv
rules.what: pyproject.toml and uv.lock disagree, or uv is not installed.
rules.why: An unlocked environment means two machines run different code paths from the same commit.
rules.fix: Run `uv lock --project scripts`, commit scripts/uv.lock, and make sure uv is on PATH.
